recruitment_plan.population_description: 18歳以上で、ja-JP版PCSの説明と同意文を日本語で理解し、自発的に閉鎖betaへ参加できるオンライン成人ボランティア。確率標本ではなく、一般人口代表性を主張しない。

sample_size_plan.stopping_rule: Stop Wave 01 recruitment at 1000 eligible complete baseline records or 56 days after collection activation, whichever occurs first. Do not stop early or extend the wave based on favorable/unfavorable psychometric results; any extension requires a documented preregistration amendment/new wave decision.
sample_size_plan.shortfall_rule: If eligible complete baseline N is below 800 at the planned close, treat Wave 01 as pilot/descriptive evidence. Do not claim held-out structural confirmation or stable-model promotion from this wave.
sample_size_plan.rationale: The instrument contains 147 ordinal items across 21 proposed direct Traits. The target is an operationally conservative preregistration choice intended to support item/reliability review plus a deterministic holdout, not a universal participants-per-item rule. Final adequacy is judged from model complexity, communalities, convergence, uncertainty and limitations.
uncertainty_or_precision_targets: report confidence intervals for reliability and retest estimates where estimable
report structural fit indices together rather than selecting a single favorable metric
report item/factor estimates with uncertainty or stability diagnostics where feasible
sample_size_plan.factor_analysis_complexity_note: All-item structural review spans 147 ordinal items and 21 proposed Traits. Development analyses may use polychoric/ordinal methods with oblique factors; held-out CFA is attempted only when the achieved holdout size and model behavior support estimation.
sample_size_plan.expected_retest_attrition: Plan for 200 completed retests. Recruitment/invitation mechanics may invite more participants, but retest interpretation is downgraded when completed N is below 150.
sample_size_plan.subgroup_or_dif_scope: Wave 01 does not collect demographic fields in calibration export v0.1, so subgroup DIF/measurement-invariance inference is outside Wave 01. A separately reviewed consent/schema version is required before such analyses.

retest_plan.attrition_rule: Analyze all eligible linked retests completed within the 14–21 day window under the exact same wave/model. Report completion/attrition counts. If completed retest N < 150, treat stability estimates as descriptive/low-precision and do not use them to support stable-model promotion.
retest_plan.context_change_recording_rule: Before retest activation, add only a bounded, separately reviewed context-change indicator if justified; no free text. If no approved context-change field exists, report that limitation explicitly rather than inferring unchanged context.

exclusion_plan.sensitivity_rule: Response-style flags are analyzed in sensitivity analyses and reported; they do not silently remove participants from the primary dataset.

holdout_plan.assignment_rule: Compute SHA-256 over calibrationRecordId UTF-8 bytes; interpret the first 8 hex digits as an unsigned integer; modulo 100 values 0–69 are development and 70–99 are holdout.
holdout_plan.holdout_access_rule: Do not inspect holdout psychometric outcomes for model-changing decisions until development-sample item/trait decisions and the item-change ledger are frozen for the wave.
holdout_plan.shortfall_rule: If achieved total eligible N < 800 or the holdout model is not estimable, report the limitation and do not reuse the development sample as a confirmatory substitute.

notes: This is a registration-ready candidate, not an externally preregistered study.
No participant collection or export is authorized by this file.
Target N=1000 and minimum N=800 are Wave 01 operational decisions, not universal sample-size rules.
Wave 01 does not collect demographics and therefore does not support DIF/invariance inference.
Any post-registration change to sample, exclusion, holdout, retest or version scope requires a documented amendment/new wave decision.
Operator authentication/role-management tooling is repository-implemented, but production operator provisioning evidence remains absent.
Repository candidate version scope is frozen by SHA-256 identity manifest; this is not external preregistration.
Privacy-preserving retest linkage persistence/schema/credential foundation is implemented, but runtime issue/claim and final retest consent approval remain disabled/pending.

analysis_decision_policy.ordinal_item_method: Use ordinal-aware/polychoric structural analysis where feasible; do not treat 1–5 responses as automatically interval-normal.
analysis_decision_policy.exploratory_structure: Use parallel-analysis evidence plus oblique exploratory factor review; also review per-Trait unidimensionality rather than forcing the planned 21-Trait structure.
analysis_decision_policy.held_out_confirmation: Use the deterministic holdout for CFA/held-out structural review only when sample size/model convergence support it.
analysis_decision_policy.trigger_semantics: Every numeric threshold is a preregistered review trigger, not an automatic validation/pass/fail rule. Theory, item content, uncertainty, model convergence, confidence intervals and neighboring evidence are reviewed together.
retest_statistics: absolute-agreement ICC with explicit formula and 95% CI

demographic_dif_policy.rule: Do not add demographic fields solely to satisfy a validation checklist. DIF/invariance requires a separately justified consent/export schema, adequate subgroup sample, and a new or amended preregistration.
